newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish steel maker seeks IPO within six months.
newsitem.headline: Polish steel maker seeks IPO within six months.

text.p: Polish steel maker Stalprodukt SA plans an initial public offering of 2.3 million to three million shares over the next six months, the company's president said on Friday.
"The issue should bring the firm about 50 million zlotys," Piotr Janeczek told a news conference, adding that the issue's prospectus would be submitted on September 30.

Janeczek said the brokerage unit of Bank Pekao SA would help prepare both the prospect and new-share issue, funds from which would go towards new energy-saving technology in producing sheet metal and other products.
Stalprodukt is 40-percent owned by the Krakow-based Huta im Sendzimira steel mill, with the remaining shares held by employees.
It made a net profit of 19 million zlotys last year on sales of 297 million zlotys, 85 million zlotys of which were from exports.
